job.title: Quality and Technical Specialist
job.description:
Are you a quality professional who thrives on accuracy, compliance, and technical documentation?

Our client is a family-owned organisation specialising in premium complementary medicine and functional food ingredients across Australia and New Zealand. Recognised for the quality of their ingredients and industry-leading technical documentation, they partner with some of the region's most recognised health and wellness brands. As the business continues to grow, they are seeking a Quality & Technical Specialist to join their Scientific Affairs team. 

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys vendor assurance, raw material assessment, quality systems, and technical documentation within a GMP-regulated environment. The role is predominantly office-based and offers the opportunity to become a key contributor to the company's future quality digitalisation initiatives.

About the Role

Reporting to the Senior Scientific Affairs Specialist, you will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and compliance of complementary medicine and functional food ingredients supplied throughout Australia and New Zealand.

Key responsibilities include:
  • Managing and maintaining Vendor Qualification Packages and Technical Information Packages.
  • Evaluating raw materials and reviewing technical documentation from a quality and compliance perspective.
  • Maintaining quality systems, SOPs, change controls, and non-conformance processes.
  • Ensuring manufacturer declarations, permits, certifications, and supporting documentation remain current and compliant.
  • Liaising with suppliers, regulatory bodies, and internal stakeholders regarding quality requirements.
  • Supporting vendor assurance activities and product compliance initiatives.
  • Assisting with the implementation of quality system improvements and future digitalisation projects.
About You

To be successful, you will bring: 
  • Experience working in Quality Assurance within the  complementary medicines industry.
  • Strong knowledge of GMP, PIC/S requirements, and TGA regulations.
  • Experience reviewing technical documentation, specifications, and supplier quality documentation.
  • A Bachelor's degree in a scientific discipline such as Chemistry, Food Science, Pharmaceutical Science, Naturopathy or a related field.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and documentation management skills.
  • Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
What's on Offer?
  • Join a successful and growing Australian business with an excellent industry reputation.
  • Genuine work-life balance: standard hours around 8:45am–4:45pm and an early finish (3pm) every Friday
  • Opportunity to lead future quality system digitalisation projects.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Daily catered team lunches.
  • On-site parking available.
If you are passionate about quality, enjoy technical documentation and compliance, and want to join a business where your contribution will genuinely make an impact, we would love to hear from you. Should you wish to have a confidential conversation about this role, please email Grace Bitodi at gbitodi@onqrecruitment.com. au. Kindly note that application submitted via email will not be considered.

job.title: Omnichannel Manager (Medical Affairs)
job.description:
An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Omnichannel Manager to join the Medical Affairs team of a leading pharmaceutical organisation. This newly created role will play a critical part in building and embedding omnichannel capability across multiple therapeutic areas, supporting scientific engagement and medical communications through innovative digital strategies. Based in Sydney, this position offers a flexible hybrid working model.

About the Role
Reporting to the Medical Director, you will be responsible for designing and implementing digital customer engagement initiatives, ensuring Medical Affairs content reaches healthcare professionals through the most effective and compliant channels.

Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and execute omnichannel engagement strategies across multiple therapeutic areas.
  • Create and implement scientific content dissemination plans.
  • Partner with Medical Affairs teams to optimise healthcare professional engagement.
  • Support MSL teams with digital engagement tools and customer communication strategies.
  • Leverage platforms, email campaigns, websites and medical information channels.
  • Utilise customer insights, segmentation and performance data to improve engagement outcomes.
  • Manage external agencies and content vendors.
  • Develop dashboards and reporting to monitor campaign effectiveness and customer engagement.
  • Ensure all activities align with Medicines Australia Code, regulatory requirements and medical compliance standards.
  • Drive adoption of best-practice omnichannel approaches across Medical Affairs.
  

This is a rare opportunity to shape a medical omnichannel function from the ground up within a highly respected and innovation-focused healthcare organisation.

About You
You are a highly proactive and commercially aware omnichannel professional who enjoys working autonomously and influencing stakeholders in a complex matrix environment.

To be successful, you will bring:
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing omnichannel strategies within the pharmaceutical, healthcare or life sciences sector.
  • Experience supporting field-based teams through digital content and customer engagement programs.
  • Experience managing agencies and content development partners.
  • Strong analytical capability with experience using dashboards, reporting tools and customer insights.
  • Ability to navigate ambiguity and build new capabilities within a growing function.
Desirable
  • Knowledge of Medicines Australia Code and healthcare compliance frameworks.
  • Exposure to therapeutic areas such as Cardiometabolic Health, Obesity, Neuroscience, Oncology or Immunology.
  

What's on Offer
  • 12-month temporary contract (view of extension).
  • Hybrid working model (3 days office, 2 days from home).
  • Opportunity to build a new capability within Medical Affairs.
  • High visibility role with senior stakeholders.
  • Exposure to global digital and omnichannel initiatives.
  • Collaborative and supportive team culture.
  

If you are passionate about transforming scientific engagement through digital innovation and are looking for a unique opportunity to make a meaningful impact, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Senior Pharmacovigilance Manager, Sydney
job.description:
Our client, a global healthcare organisation with a market-leading portfolio, is seeking a Senior Pharmacovigilance Manager to lead PV across Australia and New Zealand. Reporting to the Medical Director and holding a seat on the Medical Leadership Team, this is a rare opportunity to influence strategy, build organisational capability and develop a high-performing team while serving as the recognised Pharmacovigilance expert across the business.


The Opportunity
Leading a highly capable Pharmacovigilance team, this role is ultimately about building capability, developing future leaders and creating a strong talent pipeline for the organisation.

You will provide strategic oversight of all Pharmacovigilance activities across Australia and New Zealand, ensuring compliance with local and global regulations while partnering with senior stakeholders to drive both business outcomes and patient safety excellence. Responsibilities include leadership of PV operations, safety reporting, compliance activities, regulatory interactions, audits, inspections and quality initiatives.

About You
You are a respected Pharmacovigilance professional with:
  • Significant experience within Pharmacovigilance in the pharmaceutical industry
  • Demonstrated success leading, coaching and developing teams
  • Strong knowledge of Australian and New Zealand PV regulations
  • The ability to influence and collaborate with diverse stakeholder groups
  • A passion for developing people and building future leaders
  • Strong executive presence and confidence contributing at leadership level
  • A degree in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Medical Sciences or a related discipline
  
This is a rare opportunity to step into a highly visible leadership role where your influence extends well beyond PV operations.

What's on Offer
  • Enticing salary package with performance-based bonus opportunity
  • Excellent pipeline
  • Comprehensive company benefits and wellbeing offerings
  • Strong commitment to career development and leadership growth
  • A high-impact leadership role with visibility across the business
  • Hybrid working environment (Sydney based)
  
If you're ready to step into a role where leadership, influence and team development are just as important as your technical PV expertise, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: APS6 Website and Data Management Contractor - AusDevPortal
job.description:
An exciting opportunity exists for an experienced Website & Data Management Specialist to support the ongoing delivery, maintenance and enhancement of a high-profile public-facing transparency portal.
This role sits within a collaborative communications and engagement team and is ideal for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of data, technology and business operations. You'll play a key role in ensuring information is accurate, accessible and meaningful, while helping drive continuous improvements across website functionality, data quality and reporting processes.
This is a hands-on role that combines website administration, data management, stakeholder engagement, testing, governance and process improvement.

About the Role:
  • Managing website administration activities and coordinating enhancements with external service providers
  • Supporting website testing, deployment activities and issue resolution
  • Maintaining complex Excel-based datasets and ensuring data accuracy and integrity
  • Managing data uploads, validation processes and quality assurance activities
  • Supporting data visualisation, reporting and analytics initiatives
  • Identifying opportunities to improve data processes and operational efficiency
  • Liaising with technical and non-technical stakeholders to deliver practical solutions
  • Assisting with governance activities, documentation and user guidance materials
  • Supporting ongoing platform improvements, user experience enhancements and digital initiatives
About You:
  • NV1 Security Clearance (minimum requirement)
  • Advanced Excel skills, including formulas, data validation, data integration and pivot tables
  • Experience supporting websites, digital platforms or content management systems such as GovCMS, WordPress or similar
  • Strong data management, reporting and analytical capabilities
  • Experience using Power BI, Tableau or similar visualisation tools
  • Excellent stakeholder engagement and communication skills
  • The ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes
  • Strong problem-solving skills with a focus on continuous improvement
  • MUST be an Australian CITIZEN. 
Highly regarded:
  • Jira or Azure DevOps experience
  • Knowledge of XML and HTML
  • Experience working in Agile environments
  • Experience developing user guides, training materials or process documentation
  • Exposure to information management, governance or public sector reporting environments
Why Apply?
  • Work on a nationally visible digital platform
  • Broad and varied role combining digital, data and stakeholder engagement
  • Collaborative and supportive team environment
  • Opportunity to contribute to meaningful public outcomes
  • Exposure to senior stakeholders and strategic initiatives
  • Long-term contract opportunity within a high-performing environment
How to Apply?
For more information about this role, contact Rennel Richardson at rrichardson@onqrecruitment.com.au

job.title: Consumer Marketing Associate
job.description:
A fantastic opportunity has arisen for a Consumer Marketing Associate to join a leading global healthcare organisation supporting large-scale consumer awareness and disease education initiatives across Australia and New Zealand.
  
This role is ideal for a marketing professional who enjoys campaign execution, project management, stakeholder engagement, and working in a highly regulated environment. You'll play a key role in bringing integrated marketing campaigns to life, partnering with internal stakeholders and leading creative and media agencies to deliver high-quality consumer-facing initiatives.
  

About the Role
Working closely with the Consumer Marketing team, you'll support the end-to-end delivery of consumer education and awareness campaigns across multiple channels. From agency briefing and asset development through to compliance approvals, implementation and reporting, you'll help ensure campaigns are delivered on time, on budget, and to the highest quality standards.

This is a fantastic opportunity to gain exposure to large-scale omnichannel campaigns across digital, social, search, video, pharmacy, out-of-home, and traditional media channels.
  
Key Responsibilities
    • Coordinate end-to-end marketing and consumer education campaigns
    • Manage relationships with creative and media agencies
    • Develop campaign briefs and oversee asset delivery
    • Review content for quality, consistency, and compliance
    • Manage timelines, approvals, and stakeholder communications
    • Support campaign reporting, performance tracking, and marketing operations

  
About You
You are a highly organised marketing professional who thrives on managing multiple moving parts and enjoys turning strategy into execution.
  
To be successful, you'll bring:
    • Experience in marketing, campaign coordination, communications, or project management
    • Strong stakeholder and agency management skills
    • Experience working in a regulated industry (pharma, healthcare, medical devices, consumer health, financial services, etc.)
    • Exposure to digital and omnichannel marketing
    • Highly organised with exceptional attention to detail
    • Proactive, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities
    • Pharmaceutical, healthcare, or consumer health marketing experience will be highly regarded
  
  
What's on Offer?
    • Work on large-scale consumer awareness campaigns across ANZ
    • Exposure to the full campaign lifecycle, from concept through to launch
    • Collaborate with leading agencies and cross-functional teams
    • Immediate start available
    • 12-month contract with strong extension potential

  
If you're looking for an opportunity to develop your marketing career in a fast-paced, highly visible environment and enjoy bringing campaigns to life, we'd love to hear from you.
  
Apply now or contact Jodie Jokhan for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Senior Systems Engineer
job.description:
Senior Systems Engineer | Medical Devices | Melbourne (On-site)
Here’s a question worth sitting with: when was the last time you got to build a medical device from a genuinely blank page?
Not a refresh. Not a version two. An entirely new platform, from zero, with the budget and the backing to see it through.

That’s the brief on offer a successful a Melbourne medtech business bringing its next-generation device to life from the ground up. This is a rare one: a fully funded, board-approved, multi-year R&D program, and a Senior Systems Engineer role built to lead the systems architecture for it from day one through to commercialisation.
You’ll also help steer the final stretch of the R&D project alongside the team, before shifting your full focus to the new platform.

What you’ll be doing
  • Owning systems architecture for a next-generation medical device, from concept through to production handover.
  • Mentoring and guiding a junior systems engineer.
  • Working closely with a small, close-knit R&D team, mechanical, electrical and production, to keep everyone building toward the same architecture.
  • Partnering directly with the Head of R&D  as a trusted technical sounding board.
  • Helping raise the bar on documentation and engineering rigour as the team scales.
What you’ll bring
  • Class 3 medical device experience, essential.
  • Hands-on FDA submission experience, essential.
  • A background in medical devices, essential.
  • C++ experience, desirable.
  • Embedded software exposure, highly regarded but not essential.
  • The confidence to influence engineers you don’t manage, and the patience to bring people with you.
  • You’re based in Melbourne now, and genuinely want to be here on-site with the team.
Why this one’s worth a conversation
  • Ground-up ownership: this is a true zero-to-one systems engineering brief, not maintenance on someone else’s design.  Only Permanent Residents or Australian Citizens are eligible to apply.
